integrity: Infinite assertions proved using an exact inclusion-exclusion identity, 2-adic isometry and valuation separation. A standalone recurrence-based Python verifier provides finite corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the fifth Stirling-number column modulo powers of two. Kwong already proved the least eventual period; it is not claimed as original. Historical priority has residual risk and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Uniform binary residue fibers of the fifth Stirling column with sharp preperiod
